free_tier.stated: no standing free tier: accounts need spendable credit and a request returns HTTP 402 when credit is low; a manually reviewed builder-credit pilot grants USD 5 to USD 20 that expires 60 days after issuance

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client (OpenAI SDK, LiteLLM, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK) with a scoped Grid key
chaining: pairs with an OpenAI-compatible agent, but every request spends USD-denominated service credit; the scarce link is a funded account

limits.value: requests need spendable USD credit; HTTP 402 when the account lacks enough credit for the quoted request

binding_note: there is no free allowance, so the need for credit binds before any rate

identity_cost.detail: a scoped API key with inference.submit (and account.read for quotes) is created in the console; no card field is shown on the docs pages, but credit must be added before a request succeeds

reliability_note: workers are community-operated and model availability follows connected workers; a discovered model is not an uptime guarantee
confidence_note: the verdict rests on the cited first-party evidence; confidence is documented

evidence.proved: an HTTP 402 means the account needs more spendable credit
evidence.quote: An HTTP `402` means the account needs more currently spendable credit; it does not mean the key or client configuration is invalid.

evidence.proved: builder credits are USD 5-20 and expire 60 days after issuance
evidence.quote: Grants expire 60 days after issuance and are issued only while the finite campaign budget and promotional-credit rail are active.

notes: builder credits are a reviewed pilot capped at USD 5-20 and expiring after 60 days, not a standing free tier.
